test_lora_format_adapter: test the LoRA format adapter by running all format detection and normalization checks against public Hugging Face LoRA checkpoints
run_lora_format_tests: run end-to-end LoRA format detection and normalization tests on SDXL, FLUX, Kohya, and ComfyUI checkpoints
detect_lora_format_from_state_dict: detect the LoRA format (STANDARD, XLABS_FLUX, KOHYA_FLUX, AI_TOOLKIT_FLUX, NON_DIFFUSERS_SD) from a state dictionary
normalize_lora_state_dict: normalize a LoRA state dictionary from a non-standard format to the diffusers/PEFT standard format
test_lora_format_adapter_all_formats: test the TestLoRAFormatAdapter class by running all LoRA format adapter test cases and asserting they pass
